_comment: Integration/test lane wall-clock budgets (#1565). Each lane has budget_seconds (asserted when a CI step measures the lane and calls verify-integration-time-budget.ps1 -Lane <name> -MeasuredSeconds <n>) and hard_cap_seconds (job/go-test timeout, the fail-closed ceiling). Budgets are generous vs observed CI durations so normal jitter never trips them, but lane growth beyond budget requires an explicit baseline update (tracked approval with owner/review/rationale). Evidence rows are the observed durations with run/date references.

hub-integration.rationale: hub-server/tests/integration lane (go test -tags integration, real PostgreSQL+Redis). CI test-step observed 39-46s; budget 300s = 5min headroom; hard cap 1200s = go test -timeout=20m (job timeout-minutes 25).

hub-short.rationale: go-hub 'Test (unit only, skip integration)' step. CI observed 48s; budget 300s; hard cap 600s = go test default -timeout=10m.

hub-race.rationale: go-hub 'Race detection' step. CI observed 135s; budget 480s = 8min; hard cap 600s = go test default -timeout=10m.

edge-short.rationale: go-edge 'Test (unit only, skip integration)' step. CI observed 41s; budget 300s; hard cap 600s = go test default -timeout=10m.

edge-race.rationale: go-edge 'Race detection' step. CI observed 91s; budget 480s = 8min; hard cap 600s = go test default -timeout=10m.

edge-e2e.rationale: edge-server/tests hub_e2e lane (subprocess protocol, skipped by -short in CI, runs locally). Not measured in CI; local-run evidence to be appended as it accumulates.
